Phillip Kilazoglou​

Paralegal​

Philip is currently studying a Bachelor of Laws and a Bachelor of Business (Finance) at Western Sydney University. The combination of studying a Business degree along with a Law degree allows Phillip to assist the Solicitors at Nolan Lawyers in more complex financial and property proceedings.

Phillip has been working in Family Law since 2018, providing him with experience which enables him to assist the solicitors at Nolan Lawyers.
